description: Recursive replacement translates a propositional formula into each standard complete basis while preserving every valuation value.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.toBasis_correct.{u} {α : Type u}
  (b : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropBasis)

  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.InBasis b (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.toBasis b A) ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.toBasis b A) A
